content: As of Spring Cloud 2025.0.0 (Northfields), Spring Cloud Gateway MVC is deprecated in favor of Spring Cloud Gateway Server WebMVC, a non-reactive gateway built on Spring MVC + Java 21 virtual threads, avoiding the steep learning curve of the reactive/WebFlux-based classic Spring Cloud Gateway. For teams not already invested in reactive programming, Server WebMVC is the recommended entry point in 2025/2026.
